title: God of War
japaneseTitle: ゴッド・オブ・ウォー
shortDescription: Cory Barlog's monumental single-take cinematic reinvention of Kratos, navigating fatherhood alongside son Atreus across the realms of Norse myth.
historicalSignificance: Radically reinvented a legendary franchise with an unbroken single-shot camera, emotional father-son depth, and tactile Leviathan Axe combat, winning Game of the Year 2018 and selling over 23 million copies.

editorialContent.overview: Stepping away from the Greek pantheon into the frozen wilderness of Midgard, God of War reconstructs Kratos as a grieving widower struggling to mentor his young son Atreus on a solemn pilgrimage to scatter his wife's ashes atop the highest peak.
editorialContent.gameplay: Pioneered over-the-shoulder third-person visceral melee anchored by the recallable Leviathan Axe, Guardian Shield deflections, runic magic runes, and cooperative combat commands with Atreus's bow.
editorialContent.technicalInnovation: Celebrated for executing a seamless 'no-cut camera' from start to finish without a single camera fade or loading transition during entire 30-hour campaign.
editorialContent.culturalImpact: Won Game of the Year at The Game Awards 2018 against Red Dead Redemption 2, validating artistic maturity in legacy character evolution.
editorialContent.preservationNotes: Released on PS4 Blu-ray, updated with 60 FPS patch for PS5, and ported to PC with ultrawide and DLSS support.

awards: The Game Awards Game of the Year 2018
